title: Released CLI v3.3.0 broke `flows run` on prod for callers without a selected workspace: it sent a blank X-Workspace-Id
summary: CLI v3.3.0 (echopoint-cli#75) shipped at 01:57Z to let callers select a workspace. Its generated client stores `X-Workspace-Id` as a plain string, so every call built with a params struct sent the header **blank** when no workspace was selected. The API refuses a blank header with 400 and only defaults an *omitted* one to the organization's only workspace (echopoint#677, merged 27 minutes earlier). Every CLI and Action caller on `latest` without `--workspace` / `workspace-id` lost `flows run --tag`, `flows run <id>`, `analytics` and `spec pull`. Our own gate hit the same 400 at 01:58Z, but went green a minute later once it began passing the workspace explicitly, so the break looked like the known SEV2. The 05:08Z suite routine found it when a new flow failed to launch; echopoint-cli#77 drops the blank header and ships as v3.3.1.

impact.text: Customers who updated the CLI or used the GitHub Action (installs `latest` by default) without selecting a workspace got 400 `X-Workspace-Id ... minLength: got 0` on prod from 01:57Z. `flows list`, `flows get` and other commands that pass no params kept working, which hid the scope. The number of affected callers is unknown: the OpenAPI validator answers before request logging, so no log row records these 400s.

numbers.label: v3.3.0 latest, broken for default config
command families refused (run --tag, run <id>, analytics x3, spec pull, folder delete)
log rows: validator 400s are not logged

trigger: Release of CLI v3.3.0 at 01:57:24Z (echopoint-cli#75) and the Action `v1` tag moving to it: callers without a selected workspace sent `X-Workspace-Id: ` (blank).
detection: The 01:58Z echopoint post-deploy gate failed on this exact 400, but ci-workflows#35 (explicit `workspace-id`) merged at 01:57:50Z and the next gate passed at 02:01Z, so the failure was read as the known SEV2 rollout. The 05:08Z routine detected it at 05:13:36Z when `echopoint: workspace default` failed at the ephemeral claim with released v3.3.0 and no workspace set, while v3.2.1 passed.
resolution: echopoint-cli#77 makes `WithWorkspaceHeader("")` delete the blank header generated params set, with a test on a generated request. Verified live on prod: v3.3.0 `analytics summary` and `flows run` 400, the fixed build 200. Merging `fix:` releases v3.3.1, which the Action's `latest` picks up. Workaround until then: pass `--workspace` / `ECHOPOINT_WORKSPACE_ID` / Action `workspace-id`, or pin CLI v3.2.1.

whys.problem: Prod CLI and Action callers without a selected workspace got 400 on `flows run`, analytics and spec pull for ~3.5 h

because.text: CLI v3.3.0 sent `X-Workspace-Id` blank, and the API refuses a blank header while it defaults only an omitted one
Generated params hold the header as a plain string, so any call passing params sets it, blank without a selection
The CLI client was generated from the contract where the header was required, not from #677's optional one
because.evidence: #677 merged 01:30Z with `required: false`; #75 merged 01:56Z still generated as required

because.text: Nothing checks the CLI's generated client against the server contract it will meet at merge or release
The request editor only set a selected workspace; it never removed a blank one
The no-workspace test called the editor on a bare request, and #75's E2E proof ran with explicit selection only
because.evidence: `TestMissingWorkspaceDoesNotInventSelection`; #35 body: suites passed 'with explicit control-plane selection'

because.text: No end-to-end check runs the CLI in its default configuration (no workspace selected), the one every existing user has
Every Action caller got v3.3.0 within a minute of the release
because.evidence: Action `cli-version` defaults to `latest`; `v1` tag moved to 60d8b00 by the release job

because.text: The release job publishes and moves `v1` as soon as a `feat`/`fix` commit lands on main
A CLI release reaches every CI caller at once: `latest` by default, no soak or staged tag move
It took 3 h 15 min to see, although our gate failed on it at 01:58Z
because.evidence: infra run 39706486360 failed with the blank-header 400; run 39708813975 passed after ci-workflows#35

because.text: The gate switched to explicit `workspace-id` a minute later, so it no longer exercised the customers' configuration
Every gate pins every optional selection, so the default configuration has no automated signal after a release
Validator 400s write no log row, so no alert or query could count refused customer calls
because.evidence: PostHog logs `echopoint`: 0 rows matching `X-Workspace-Id` over 24 h

because.text: OpenAPI validator refusals are invisible to logs and metrics

contributing: Two companion fixes (#677 server default, #75 client selection) merged 26 minutes apart during a SEV2, each proved against the other's previous state.
Commands that pass no params (`flows list`, `flows get`, `flows create`) kept working, so a quick smoke check of v3.3.0 looked green.

well: The routine builds new flows with the released CLI, so the first launch exposed the break.
A raw `curl` with and without the blank header isolated the cause in one step.
wrong: A failed gate during an open SEV2 was attributed to it without reading the exact error (blank vs missing).
The release proof covered the configuration CI uses, not the one customers use.
lucky: #677 shipped first: without the server default, v3.3.0 users without a workspace would have failed on every command, not six.
Customer usage of the Action is still small; the same release on a larger base would have broken many CI pipelines at once.

actions.what: Drop a blank X-Workspace-Id in the request editor; test a generated request with params and no selection
Run the routine's suites with the released CLI and no workspace selected (default configuration) on every run
CLI CI fails when the generated client differs from echopoint main's `cmd/http/openapi.yaml` regeneration
Add a released-CLI default-configuration smoke (no workspace-id) to the post-deploy gate
Stage CLI releases: move the Action `v1` tag after a soak run, or default the Action to a pinned version
Count OpenAPI validator refusals by operation and parameter (metric or log at info) and alert on a spike (shared with SEV2 A5)
Skill line: run at least one gate with the released client in its default configuration

messaging.internal: SEV2: CLI v3.3.0 sends a blank X-Workspace-Id when no workspace is selected; prod answers 400 on flows run, analytics and spec pull. Fix echopoint-cli#77 (v3.3.1). Workaround: --workspace / ECHOPOINT_WORKSPACE_ID / Action workspace-id, or pin v3.2.1.
messaging.external: Echopoint CLI 3.3.0 and the GitHub Action could fail with "X-Workspace-Id ... minLength" when no workspace was configured. Update to 3.3.1 (`echopoint update`); the Action picks it up automatically.
